candidates.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching
candidates.reason: GPU-resident predictorで下流MLP sparse activityを先読みし、resident bufferとの差分rowだけをapplication-scheduled NVMe readするstorage-backed inference system。実機unified-memory edge hardwareでllama.cpp比7.9-12.0x。

candidates.title: NVLLM: A 3D NAND-Centric Architecture Enabling Edge on-Device LLM Inference
candidates.reason: FFNを3D NAND内computeへ移しattentionをlogic+DRAMで処理するflash-centric architecture。30B級まで評価しA800 out-of-core比16.7-37.9x。SSD/near-storage系統の強いhardware-system候補。

candidates.title: INF^2: High-Throughput Generative Inference of Large Language Models using Near-Storage Processing
candidates.reason: computational storage deviceへattentionをoffloadしdelayed KV writeback/cooperative cacheでI/Oを削減するnear-storage inference framework。PyTorch実機で最大3.46x throughput。

discovery_stats.axis: NVMe delta prefetch・3D NAND compute・near-storage attention
discovery_stats.query_summary: storage/OS/HPC隣接から、単なるSSD offloadではなくmodel-aware NVMe schedulingとnear-storage computeを持つsystemsを探索。canonical IDを最新default branchへ再照合した。
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: GPU memory allocator・virtual memory・request migrationの既存取りこぼしを走査する
